instructions.content: file= resolves a note like a wikilink (name only, no path or extension needed); path= requires the exact path from vault root including extension.
instructions.original_snippets: file=<name> -- resolves like a wikilink (name only, no path or extension needed); path=<path> -- exact path from vault root, e.g. folder/note.md

instructions.content: NEVER use path= when the note name is unique across the vault; prefer file= since path= tightly couples commands to folder structure and breaks silently if the file moves.
instructions.original_snippets: NEVER use path= when the note name is unique across the vault ... Prefer file= unless you need to disambiguate files with the same name in different folders.

instructions.content: NEVER pass a parameter value containing spaces without quotes; the CLI tokenises on whitespace and an unquoted value is parsed as separate tokens.
instructions.original_snippets: NEVER pass parameter values that contain spaces without surrounding quotes ... the CLI tokenises on whitespace

instructions.content: NEVER omit the silent flag when creating or updating files from an agent workflow; without it Obsidian opens the file and hijacks the user's editor focus.
instructions.original_snippets: NEVER omit the silent flag when creating or updating files from an agent workflow ... Without silent, Obsidian opens the created or updated file in the editor.

instructions.content: NEVER embed obsidian eval calls in production plugin code; eval runs arbitrary JavaScript in the app context and is a development/debugging tool only.
instructions.original_snippets: NEVER embed obsidian eval calls in production plugin code ... It is a development and debugging tool only.

instructions.content: Always specify vault=<name> as the first parameter when the user may have more than one vault open and vault identity matters, since focus can shift silently between vaults.
instructions.original_snippets: NEVER omit vault=<name> when the user may have more than one vault open and vault identity matters ... Always specify vault=<name> as the first parameter when vault identity matters.

instructions.content: Parameters take a value with =; flags are boolean switches with no value.
instructions.original_snippets: Parameters take a value with =. Quote values with spaces ... Flags are boolean switches with no value

instructions.content: For multiline content passed as a single CLI parameter value, encode newlines as \n and tabs as \t.
instructions.original_snippets: For multiline content use \n for newline and \t for tab.

instructions.content: Plugin develop/test cycle after a code change: reload the plugin, check for errors, verify visually with a screenshot or DOM inspection, then check console output; repeat from reload if errors appear.
instructions.original_snippets: 1. Reload the plugin to pick up changes ... 2. Check for errors -- if errors appear, fix and repeat from step 1 ... 3. Verify visually ... 4. Check console output

instructions.content: Commands target the most recently focused vault by default when no vault= parameter is given.
instructions.original_snippets: Commands target the most recently focused vault by default. Use vault=<name> as the first parameter to target a specific vault

instructions.content: Use --copy on any command to copy output to the clipboard, and total on list commands to get a count.
instructions.original_snippets: Use --copy on any command to copy output to clipboard. Use silent to prevent files from opening. Use total on list commands to get a count.
